heading: Librarian of Congress: reports
lead: Five thousand copies of the annual and special reports of the Librarian of Congress submitted to Congress, shall be printed and bound in cloth for the Library of Congress.

notes.text: Historical and Revision NotesBased on 44 U.S. Code, 1964 ed., § 156 (Feb. 24, 1904, No. 8, 33 Stat. 583).
